fixed.provider_endpoint: z.ai (api.z.ai), anthropic-compatible base https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic for the claude harness

sampling_rule: every footnote node whose PR merged 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, PR added at least one new test file, tests under 10 minutes; systematic sample of 10 (k=round(N/10), offset k/2), epic/meta excluded; prompt carries no sha and no PR number
stop_rule: stop and report when the next attempt would pass the ceiling; never raise it
decision_rules: a: opencode or zcode beats claude-code on accepted changes, or matches at 30% lower cost per accepted change -> recommend GLM routing change in config.routing.models (recommendation only)
b: every external harness shares one named GLM failure a loop change would fix -> name it as the child-3 deficiency target
c: no arm differs beyond noise (about 15 points at this n) -> record it and recommend closing the native branch (AC4-EDGE)
an arm under 20 graded attempts is underpowered and fires no rule alone
prices_note: GLM-5.3-Flash list price from the z.ai pricing page, read 2026-09-29: input 0.15, cached input 0.03, output 0.50 USD per 1M tokens. z.ai lists no cache-write charge and bills written tokens as input, so cache write is 0.15. The report prices by the exact model string, so every string an arm can report carries the same rates. An unlisted string reads unmeasured.

amendment_1.run0_repeats_reason: Run 0 is one pass per arm over the 89 Terminal-Bench 2 tasks, paired by task. The 3-repeat rule applies to Run 1.
amendment_1.run0_timeout: each Terminal-Bench 2 task's own agent timeout at timeout_multiplier 1.0; the 45m budget applies to Run 1
amendment_1.run0_reference_model: Terminus 2 runs glm-5.3-flash through z.ai like every other arm; the Sonnet price row is removed
amendment_1.concurrency: one Harbor job at a time with n_concurrent_trials 4; Run 1 runs one attempt at a time beside Run 0
amendment_1.stop_rule_granularity: before each Harbor job, spent USD plus 3 x the arm's smoke cost per task x 89 must stay under the ceiling; before each Run 1 lane, spent USD plus 3 x the lane's projection must stay under it

amendment_4.scope: attempts that never started; no grade or rule changes
amendment_4.docker_down: a Run 0 trial whose docker environment never started is an infrastructure exclusion; harbor jobs resume -f RuntimeError reruns it in place; unrun arms run in the same seeded order
amendment_4.provider_cap: a Run 1 spawn refused before the worker starts reads unavailable; a top-up pass reruns missing graded attempts up to 3 per task, at most 3 passes; each refusal stays counted by reason
amendment_4.started_attempts: a started attempt or trial is never rerun; it is scored as it stands
